parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The network access mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- **internet**: access over the Internet.

- **vpc**: access over an Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: AccessRegion
parameters.description:
The region for Express Connect circuit access. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Hangzhou.

- **cn-beijing**: Beijing.

- **cn-shanghai**: Shanghai.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: HttpPorts
parameters.description: The listening ports for the HTTP protocol. Separate multiple ports with commas (,), such as **port1,port2,port3**.

parameters.name: HttpsPorts
parameters.description: The listening ports for the HTTPS protocol. Separate multiple ports with commas (,), such as **port1,port2,port3**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: LogFieldsNotReturned
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated. It no longer returns meaningful data.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of protection nodes that can be added to the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: ProxyStatus
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the proxy gateway is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

- **on**: The proxy gateway is enabled.

- **off**: The proxy gateway is disabled.

parameters.name: ProxyType
parameters.description:
The type of the hybrid cloud cluster. Valid values:

- **cname**: reverse proxy cluster. Traffic is forwarded through CNAME resolution.

- **service**: transparent proxy cluster. Traffic is forwarded at the service level.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The description of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleConfig
parameters.description: The configuration of the bypass rule, in JSON format. This includes settings such as circuit breaker thresholds, request body size limits, and timeout values.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
Indicates whether manual bypass is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

- **on**: Manual bypass is enabled.

- **off**: Manual bypass is disabled.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the bypass rule. Valid values:

- **bypass**: skips WAF security checks and allows traffic to pass through directly.
